resolvedStack: React Native / Expo + Next.js 14 Web Preview + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth + Stripe
name: ColdChain Pharma Guard
description: ColdChain Pharma Guard is a mobile cold-chain compliance app for pharmaceutical logistics teams to monitor thermal sensor excursions, scan vaccine batches, and trigger GMP alerts with NextAuth, Stripe, and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: ColdChain Pharma Guard
metadata.description: Mobile cold-chain pharma app for thermal excursions, batch scans, and GMP compliance alerts.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, stripe, Zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react, react-icons.
Expo app configuration for ColdChain Pharma Guard.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, BatchStatus, AlertSeverity enums and User, PharmaBatch, ThermalExcursion, ComplianceAlert models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for PharmaBatch, ThermalExcursion, ComplianceAlert.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Mobile welcome landing screen for ColdChain Pharma Guard.
Cold-chain mobile dashboard displaying active batches, temperature excursion alerts, and compliance rate.
Pharma batch inventory and scan log screen.
Thermal excursion alerts screen with severity filter and resolution form.
Registration page calling POST /api/register then signing in.
Client hook fetching /api/batches on mount via useEffect.
Client hook fetching /api/excursions on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for PharmaBatch records.
GET and POST API route for ThermalExcursion records.
